name: Ashiya Yamato
source: A powerful exorcist that cooperates with spirits in order to seek revenge against his childhood friend, Abe Asuka for being snubbed of the position of boss of the Exorcist Association. Yamato is trying to impregnate Asuka to reduce her exorcist power to become the boss of the association.
translation: A powerful exorcist that cooperates with spirits in order to seek revenge against his childhood friend, Abe Asuka for being snubbed of the position of boss of the Exorcist Association. Yamato is trying to impregnate Asuka to reduce her exorcist power to become the boss of the association.
